featured.quote: The quality and craftsmanship of the final product exceed our expectations and we came in on time and on budget.
featured.more: I think what sets Tim apart as a builder is his superb communication skills. We were always given a thorough understanding each step of the way from design, to excavation, to the structure and fireplace, all the way to start up!

reviews.quote: Huge thanks to Island Life Custom Pools for converting our backyard into our own personal oasis. Tim (the owner) made the process very easy and stress free. He is an honest man who constantly kept his word and heard our every want/must haves and made it happen. Tim is very responsive and answered all calls and text fast. He knew how our dogs are spoiled and even made a cute trail for them!

We had a wonderful experience using Island Life to build our pool, spa and fire pit. … Even the construction crews were very nice and polite. We are so impressed with how everything turned out. It is so beautiful and we are so happy with it.
From the design to close-out, Tim and Eric were amazing! They addressed any issue big or small, listened to our needs and concerns and started working on them immediately. Our pool is beautiful.
Tim exceeded our expectations with the construction of our beautiful pool. He was extremely communicative, detail oriented and surrounded himself with quality subs.
